{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python
PROJECT=/root/recovery_aware_struct_prune
DATA_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune
MODEL_PATH=/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B
IMPORTANCE_PATH=${PROJECT}/results/importance_scores.pt
CKA_PATH=${PROJECT}/results/cka_scores.pt
SPARSITY=0.20
GPU=${1:-0}

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU

echo "=========================================="
echo "Scoring Ablation: 4 methods x prune+eval+SFT+eval"
echo "GPU: $GPU | Sparsity: $SPARSITY"
echo "=========================================="

for METHOD in magnitude gradient random cka_only; do
    PRUNE_DIR=${DATA_DIR}/pruned_${METHOD}_20
    SFT_DIR=${DATA_DIR}/sft_${METHOD}_20

    echo ""
    echo ">>> [$METHOD] Step 1/4: Pruning..."

    PRUNE_ARGS="--model_path $MODEL_PATH --mode $METHOD --sparsity $SPARSITY --output_path $PRUNE_DIR --seed 42 --skip_attention"

    if [ "$METHOD" = "gradient" ]; then
        PRUNE_ARGS="$PRUNE_ARGS --importance_path $IMPORTANCE_PATH"
    elif [ "$METHOD" = "cka_only" ]; then
        PRUNE_ARGS="$PRUNE_ARGS --cka_path $CKA_PATH"
    fi

    $PYTHON ${PROJECT}/src/prune.py $PRUNE_ARGS

    echo ">>> [$METHOD] Step 2/4: Eval post-prune..."
    $PYTHON ${PROJECT}/src/eval_gsm8k.py \
        --model_path $PRUNE_DIR \
        --max_samples 200 \
        --seed 42 \
        --output_path ${DATA_DIR}/results/eval_postprune_${METHOD}_20.json

    echo ">>> [$METHOD] Step 3/4: SFT recovery..."
    $PYTHON ${PROJECT}/src/sft_recovery.py \
        --model_path $PRUNE_DIR \
        --output_dir $SFT_DIR \
        --gpu 0 \
        --learning_rate 2e-5 \
        --num_train_epochs 2 \
        --batch_size 1 \
        --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
        --max_seq_length 2048 \
        --seed 42

    echo ">>> [$METHOD] Step 4/4: Eval post-SFT..."
    $PYTHON ${PROJECT}/src/eval_gsm8k.py \
        --model_path $SFT_DIR \
        --max_samples 200 \
        --seed 42 \
        --output_path ${DATA_DIR}/results/eval_sft_${METHOD}_20.json

    echo ">>> [$METHOD] DONE"
done

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "All scoring ablation experiments complete!"
echo "=========================================="
